title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Justice, and the General Administration of Customs on Issuing the Opinions on Further Strengthening Frontier Health and Quarantine Work and Legally Punishing Illegal and Criminal Acts that Obstruct Frontier Health and Quarantine
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security,

Ministry of Justice, and General Administration of Customs

Circular on Issuing the Opinions on Further Strengthening Border Health and Quarantine Work and Legally Punishing Illegal and Criminal Acts that Impair Border Health and Quarantine

Shu Fa Fa [2020] No. 50

To the higher people's courts, people's procuratorates, public security departments (bureaus), and justice departments (bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government; the military courts and military procuratorates of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, the Public Security Bureau, and the Justice Bureau; the Guangdong Branch of the General Administration of Customs; the Special Commissioner's Offices of the General Administration of Customs in Tianjin and Shanghai; and all directly subordinate customs offices:

To implement the Opinions of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Law-Based Governance on Law-Based Prevention and Control of the Novel Coronavirus Pneumonia Epidemic and Ensuring the People's Life and Health Safety, to ensure the effective integration of administrative law enforcement and criminal justice related to border health and quarantine and the accurate application of relevant laws and regulations, and to provide strong legal guarantees for preventing the cross-border spread of epidemic diseases, maintaining public health security, and social stability and order, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Justice, and the General Administration of Customs have jointly formulated the Opinions on Further Strengthening Border Health and Quarantine Work and Legally Punishing Illegal and Criminal Acts that Impair Border Health and Quarantine. This document is hereby issued. You are requested to implement it seriously in light of actual circumstances. If any situations or problems arise during implementation, please report to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Justice, and the General Administration of Customs respectively in a timely manner.

This circular is issued for your attention.

March 13, 2020

Opinions on Further Strengthening Border Health and Quarantine Work and Legally Punishing Illegal and Criminal Acts that Impair Border Health and Quarantine

To further strengthen border health and quarantine work, legally punish illegal and criminal acts that impair border health and quarantine, maintain public health security, and safeguard the life and health of the people, these Opinions are formulated in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and judicial interpretations.

1. Fully Understand the Significance of Border Health and Quarantine for Maintaining Public Health Security

Border health and quarantine plays an important role in preventing the introduction and spread of infectious diseases into and out of the country, safeguarding the life and health of the people, and maintaining public health security and social stability and order. The Party Central Committee and the State Council attach great importance to border health and quarantine work. Especially since the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, General Secretary Xi Jinping has made a series of important instructions and directives on strengthening the legal guarantee for public health, reforming and improving the disease prevention and control system, and improving the working mechanisms of combining prevention and treatment, joint prevention and control, and group prevention and group treatment. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, judicial administrative organs, and customs at all levels must effectively raise their political awareness, unify their thinking and actions to the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and directives, resolutely implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses," firm up the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds." From the height of implementing the holistic view of national security and promoting the construction of a community with a shared future for mankind, always put the life and health safety of the people first, and effectively improve the level of administrative law enforcement and judicial case handling in border health and quarantine. Especially in the face of the severe situation where the COVID-19 pandemic is spreading abroad and the risk of spreading into the country through ports is increasing, all types of illegal and criminal acts that impair border health and quarantine must be legally and promptly punished with strictness, to effectively build a strong line of defense for border health and quarantine, resolutely curb the spread of the epidemic through ports, and provide strong legal guarantees for maintaining public health security.

2. Legally Punish Illegal and Criminal Acts that Impair Border Health and Quarantine

To strengthen border health and quarantine work, prevent the introduction and spread of infectious diseases into and out of the country, and protect the health and safety of the people, the Criminal Law and the Border Health and Quarantine Law have stipulated provisions on illegal and criminal acts that impair border health and quarantine and their punishments. When handling cases involving impairment of border health and quarantine, people's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, and customs shall accurately understand and strictly apply the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law and the Border Health and Quarantine Law and legally punish relevant illegal and criminal acts.

(1) Further Strengthen Administrative Law Enforcement for Border Health and Quarantine. Customs shall strengthen the publicity of border health and quarantine work at all ports, guide entry-exit personnel and units and individuals subject to quarantine supervision to strictly abide by the provisions of the Border Health and Quarantine Law and other laws and regulations, and cooperate with and accept customs border health and quarantine. At the same time, intensify administrative law enforcement for border health and quarantine, and impose administrative penalties according to law for acts that violate the Border Health and Quarantine Law and its implementation rules but do not constitute a crime.

(2) Legally Punish Crimes of Impairing Border Health and Quarantine. According to Article 332 of the Criminal Law, committing any of the following acts in violation of border health and quarantine regulations constitutes an act of impairing border health and quarantine:

1. Persons infected with or suspected of being infected with quarantine infectious diseases who refuse to implement the health and quarantine measures proposed by customs in accordance with the Border Health and Quarantine Law and other laws and regulations, such as health declaration, temperature monitoring, medical inspection, epidemiological investigation, medical screening, and sampling, or health treatment measures such as isolation, retention for observation, on-site medical examination, and referral;

2. Persons infected with or suspected of being infected with quarantine infectious diseases who conceal the epidemic situation by not truthfully filling in health declaration forms, or forge circumstances by forging or falsifying quarantine forms or certificates;

3. Persons who know or should know that special items subject to approval management, such as microorganisms, human tissues, biological products, blood and its products, may cause the spread of quarantine infectious diseases, but still evade quarantine, carry, or send them into or out of the country without approval;

4. Where an infected or suspected person of quarantine infectious disease is found on an entry-exit conveyance, the person in charge of the conveyance refuses to accept health quarantine or refuses to accept health treatment;

5. Where a person dies from non-accidental causes with unknown cause on an entry-exit conveyance from a country or region where a quarantine infectious disease is prevalent, the person in charge of the conveyance intentionally conceals the situation;

6. Other acts of refusing to implement the quarantine measures proposed by customs in accordance with the Border Health and Quarantine Law and other laws and regulations.

Committing the above acts, causing the spread or a serious risk of spread of plague, cholera, yellow fever, COVID-19, and other quarantine infectious diseases determined and announced by the State Council, shall be convicted and punished as the crime of impairing border health and quarantine according to Article 332 of the Criminal Law.

For a unit that commits an act impairing border health and quarantine, causing the spread or a serious risk of spread of plague, cholera, yellow fever, COVID-19, and other quarantine infectious diseases determined and announced by the State Council, the unit shall be sentenced to a fine, and the directly responsible supervisor and other directly responsible persons shall be convicted and punished.

3. Improve and Perfect the Working Mechanism to Ensure Law-Based, Scientific, and Orderly Prevention and Control

(1) Do a Good Job of Connecting Administrative Law Enforcement with Criminal Justice. Customs shall strictly control the first pass of epidemic prevention and control at ports, strictly pursue administrative legal liability for violating border health and quarantine regulations, improve the law enforcement case-handling process, and adhere to strict law enforcement and lawful case handling. Ensure the integration of administrative law enforcement and criminal justice; for cases that meet the standards for filing and prosecuting criminal cases in the field of border health and quarantine supervision, promptly go through the relevant procedures for referral to public security organs in accordance with relevant provisions, and shall not use administrative penalties to replace criminal penalties.

(2) Accelerate Case Investigation. For criminal cases of impairing border health and quarantine, public security organs shall promptly file cases, investigate, and handle them according to law, and comprehensively collect and fix evidence. For crimes of impairing border health and quarantine occurring during the COVID-19 prevention and control period, quickly investigate and solve them, and promptly expose them to form a strong deterrent.

(3) Strengthen Procuratorial Functions. People's procuratorates shall strengthen supervision over the filing of cases involving crimes of impairing border health and quarantine; if a case should be filed but is not, they shall require the public security organ to provide reasons, and if the reasons are deemed untenable, they shall notify the public security organ to file the case according to law. For criminal cases of impairing border health and quarantine, people's procuratorates may provide suggestions and opinions to public security organs on the nature of the case, collection of evidence, and application of law. For criminal suspects suspected of the crime of impairing border health and quarantine who meet the conditions for arrest and prosecution, promptly approve arrest and initiate public prosecution. Leverage the role of procuratorial recommendations to promote systematic governance of epidemic prevention and control.

(4) Strengthen Communication and Coordination. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, judicial administrative organs, and customs shall strengthen communication and coordination, smooth contact channels, and establish normalized cooperation mechanisms. While strictly performing statutory duties, each fulfilling its own responsibilities, they shall also cooperate and coordinate with each other, achieve resource sharing and complementary advantages, and form a joint force for legally punishing illegal and criminal acts that impair border health and quarantine. For major cases with significant social impact and high public concern, in accordance with the requirements of "three simultaneous actions" of lawful handling, public opinion guidance, and social control, promptly clarify the truth of the facts, and do a good job of public opinion guidance and response.

(5) Adhere to Proportionality of Penalty to Offense. Further regulate law enforcement activities for border health and quarantine, and effectively achieve strict, standardized, fair, and civilized law enforcement. Pay attention to applying the policy of combining leniency with strictness: for administrative violations, comprehensively determine the type and extent of penalty based on the degree of harm of the violation and the attitude of repentance. For those suspected of crimes, focus on cracking down on criminal acts with egregious circumstances and serious consequences; for those with minor circumstances and sincere repentance, handle leniently according to law.

(6) Safeguard Fairness and Justice. People's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs shall protect the litigation rights, especially the right to defense, of criminal suspects and defendants according to law, effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the parties, and maintain the correct implementation of the law. Judicial administrative organs shall strengthen guidance and supervision over lawyers' defense and representation work to promote lawyers' practice in accordance with laws and regulations. People's courts, people's procuratorates, public security organs, judicial administrative organs, and customs shall earnestly implement the responsibility system of "those who enforce the law shall popularize the law," select typical cases, carry out case-based legal interpretation, strengthen warning education, deter lawbreakers, release positive energy, and create a favorable legal and social environment for epidemic prevention and control.
